answer: Edges decay 5 percent per week, so an identity re-earns 5 percent weekly or slides out of the jury pool. A recruit audited by its own inviter counts 0, and an edge only registers when the two nodes sit three or more hops apart. Panel verdicts weigh 1.0 unanimous, 0.4 at three of five, 0.0 at a 3-2 split. That dilution means an operator needs consensus from accounts it does not control, which in a wide ocean of identities means renting strangers. A clean opal of a record cannot be manufactured by a crystal of fake accounts, because the weight sits on edges it does not own.
